properties.description: Source side of the raw ingest. BINARY on purpose: a raw landing zone should hold the bytes exactly as the source published them. A Parquet dataset here would make ADF deserialise and re-serialise every file, which (a) costs DIUs for no benefit, (b) can silently change column physical types, and (c) destroys the ability to prove the file you hold is the file they published. Deserialisation happens later, in Synapse serverless, where it is cheap and re-runnable. The location still names the container even though LS_OpenDatasets_NycTlc carries a containerUri: the URI is what anonymous authentication needs, and AzureBlobStorageLocation is what folderPath is resolved against. With the container omitted, GetMetadata returned exists=false for a path that demonstrably holds blobs.
